sources.locator: p1 pinning/ratings; p6 SOA; pp8-9 Q5B package and land/stencil

requirements.description: Establish actual VGS/VDS/current envelope and required gate enhancement, not threshold voltage. Keep transient VGS inside +/-20V absolute limit with margin.
Evaluate transient SOA and repetitive thermal dissipation including every source/drain contact, copper neck and cooling path; headline current/avalanche numbers are not application guarantees.
Review p9 copper, authored central stencil adaptation, all power contacts, local gate/source return and high-current loops. No internal-pad routing exemptions or physical macro are supplied.
Bound gate ringing, Miller coupling, turnoff overshoot and fault-current time history with actual layout and clamp behavior before comparing with SOA.
Measure VGS/VDS/current and thermal behavior in startup, normal pulses and controlled faults across operating extremes.

notes: Exact bare FET and source-backed copper, not a qualified driver. Pad9 is the locally numbered exposed drain. Power contacts require external routing.
